purpose: New separate Art V2 reference, not an implemented-game screenshot
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone production concept art for Emberdeep Art V2, a hand-tracked VR tabletop firefighting miniature, PICO 4 and Quest 3. Create one polished landscape 3D art-direction board with a dominant three-quarter elevated view of a complete compact forest diorama, plus three small isolated asset studies along its lower margin: a fire hydrant with cyan coupling and brass valve, a creek intake with chunky manual pump, and a layered stylized cedar tree. The world is a hand-crafted small living forest on a softly irregular oval slice of layered earth and slate, mossy grassy surface, shallow winding turquoise creek, stepping stones, a small timber ranger cabin with terracotta roof, varied rounded/faceted cedar and broadleaf canopies, ferns, pebbles and a few cut logs. Keep the front working edge open with the water station and pump clearly reachable. Show three distinct terrain conditions in the same scene: healthy cool sage forest, a small localized orange/gold fire with graceful flame tongues and restrained charcoal smoke on the far side, and recently extinguished dark damp ground with a subtle cyan sheen. Art direction: premium stylized game asset render, lovingly sculpted broad silhouettes, bevelled edges, hand-painted color blocking with subtle roughness, tactile enamel, warm wood and moss; readable mobile VR materials, no photoreal noise. Palette grounded in deep teal, sage and mint greens, clay/terracotta warm red, brass amber details; reserve bright cyan for interactable ports and handles. Warm directional sunlight and cool sky fill, soft contact shadows. Neutral dark desaturated teal studio background, generous negative space, clear uncluttered layout. No UI panels, no text, no logos, no humans, no weapons or animals, no giant fantasy architecture, no dense foliage blocking target trees, no bloom haze or clouds hiding interaction. This is a concept reference for later Blender modeling, not a screenshot of implemented gameplay.
